title: Disco Lights Gaana Nahi Samajhti, Bas Shor Sunti Hain 🎶 #shorts
description:
Yeh lights beat pe blink karti hain, par inme koi music player nahi! Jaano KY-038 sound sensor ka asli raaz.
🎤 Electret microphone ke andar ka diaphragm aur backplate
⚡ LM393 comparator aur blue pot ka threshold
🎛️ Color organ mein bass aur treble ka split
🔌 Arduino Uno wiring ka important tip
Aur Arduino projects ke liye subscribe karo!
#shorts #arduino #soundsensor #ky038 #electronics #hindi #maker
